label: Default
description: The resting state, with nothing applied.

label: Disabled
description: Non-interactive: dimmed and removed from the tab order.

label: Loading
description: Awaiting data or an in-flight action.

label: Error
description: Invalid input or a failed action.

label: Success
description: A completed action or valid input.

label: Empty
description: No data yet: the zero state.

label: Selected
description: Chosen, checked, or on (toggles, checkbox, tabs).
